goal: Produce a written gap analysis comparing current implementation to both plan documents, with severity ratings and recommended fixes.
summary: Phase 1 complete. Delivered a 368-line gap analysis report at docs/gap_analysis.md documenting all deviations from both plan documents. Critical findings: (1) Schema uses array columns where normalized join tables are required, (2) Missing theme_relationships table, (3) Monolithic agent instead of tool-calling, (4) Unconditional reflection instead of conditional, (5) No evaluation framework, (6) No CAG mode. API contract assessed as stable with no breaking changes required. Report includes prioritized 5-phase remediation plan.
